service.en: Renew the date of an expired theory or practical driving test
service.ar: تجديد موعد اختبار القيادة النظري أو العملي
service.ur: ڈرائیونگ ٹیسٹ کی میعاد ختم تاریخ کی تجدید

about: Renew an expired date for the theory or practical driving test.
note: Requirements read from the public TAMM service page on the checked date. TAMM fills the form in after UAE PASS sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: The earlier test date has expired
timing: You receive the renewed test date
channels: TAMM website or app (sign in with UAE PASS)
